feature2.prompt: Optimize CreateModel + AlterModelManagers to CreateModel. The migration process should be enhanced so that when a CreateModel operation is immediately followed by an AlterModelManagers operation, they merge into a single CreateModel operation that includes the managers configuration. This feature focuses on ensuring that the revised behavior correctly consolidates the two operations. The expected result is a single CreateModel operation that contains all the appropriate model managers, simplifying the migration sequence.
feature2.hint_texts: Develop a new verification routine in the migration optimizer tests to simulate a scenario where a CreateModel is followed by an AlterModelManagers operation. The verification should confirm that the optimizer successfully merges these operations into one CreateModel operation that carries the managers. Ensure that the new test precisely captures and validates this behavior without affecting other migration optimizations.
